study type: Observational cohort study nested in a randomized trial
outcome: Microbiome alpha-diversity at day 7 and week 4
Microbial relative abundance at genus level
cohort: 165 infants at risk of neonatal hypoglycemia
finding: Prophylactic dextrose gel use for neonatal hypoglycemia did not significantly alter the infant gut microbiome compared to placebo gel or no gel.
